title: Fort Hommet
geometryBasis: Mapped Martello tower, enclosing wall, concrete block and Mapzen headland elevations. Two exact original photographs by Man vyi show the surviving stone and concrete profile.
sectionBasis: The short, slightly battered masonry cylinder stands within a much wider low curving stone wall. A squared natural-stone entrance return and adjoining pale gray concrete block interrupt the silhouette.
limitations: Models the visible main fort core. Outlying ruins, fixtures and interiors are outside scope.
Roof openings, small stonework and the elevation of separate parts are approximate. Mapzen data resolves the broad headland grade.
